subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a repaired 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first product slice, or require the broader daily/week calendar and editing design before implementation?
rationale: The remaining work is a new Control UI product capability, not a broken existing contract, and the open linked PR implements only part of the requested scope.

options.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase and repair the linked PR, preserve current cron behavior, and accept the 24-hour timeline as an intentional first slice while tracking or declining broader day/week/editing scope separately.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope
options.body: Pause the linked PR and define daily, weekly, stats, drag-and-drop, and validator behavior before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR after documenting that the current list/run-history UI is sufficient for core.

recommendation.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase and repair the linked PR, preserve current cron behavior, and accept the 24-hour timeline as an intentional first slice while tracking or declining broader day/week/editing scope separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI routing and cron-adjacent history make this the best available product-surface routing candidate.
